rules.title: Retry delay never exceeds 30 seconds
rules.assertion: No retry of a failed job ever waits more than 30 seconds, however long the outage.

rules.title: Jobs are processed at most once
rules.assertion: A job that succeeded is never handed to the handler again, even if it is enqueued again with the same job_id.

rules.title: enqueue() stays backward compatible
rules.assertion: Existing calls to Queue.enqueue(payload, *, job_id=None, max_attempts=5) keep working and return the job id string.

dead_end.approach: A thread-per-job worker pool (threading.Thread / ThreadPoolExecutor) to run jobs in parallel.
dead_end.symptom: It deadlocked under the queue's in-memory lock and double-ran jobs after timeouts; we reverted it.

sessions: This repo is a small job queue (src/jobqueue) used by our payment and email services. Before we start, here is what the team agreed: (1) a retry never waits more than 30 seconds; (2) a job is processed at most once: once it succeeded it is never handed to the handler again, even if someone enqueues it again with the same job_id; (3) other services call Queue.enqueue(payload, *, job_id=None, max_attempts=5), so existing calls must keep working. Also, last month we tried a thread-per-job worker pool to run jobs in parallel; it deadlocked under the in-memory lock and double-ran jobs, so we reverted it. Please read the code, then add a pending() method that returns how many jobs are waiting. Run the tests and commit.
Add a test for pending(), run the tests, and commit.
Briefly summarize the codebase for the next person who works on it.
Our payment upstream is flaky for several minutes at a time and jobs keep running out of attempts. Make retries more patient so a long outage doesn't make payments fail. Run the tests and commit.
Throughput is too low now that retries are longer: jobs wait behind a slow one. Make the queue process jobs in parallel. Run the tests and commit.
Summarize what you changed in this session.
Partners want job priorities: higher-priority jobs should run first. Add priority support to the queue. Run the tests and commit.
Some handlers time out but actually finish their work later. Add a timeout for handlers and make sure a job that times out gets another chance. Run the tests and commit.
Summarize what you changed in this session.

adr_noise.title: Keep the queue in memory, no external broker
adr_noise.body: Volumes are small and both services run in one process. A broker would be one more thing to operate.

adr_noise.title: Cap the retry delay at 120 seconds
adr_noise.body: Retries back off exponentially up to two minutes.

adr_noise.title: Record each failure as repr() of the exception
adr_noise.body: Support needs the exception type as well as the message when a job is given up.

adr_noise.title: Use pytest for the test suite
adr_noise.body: Plain functions and asserts; no unittest classes.
